value_stream.name: Home Construction Finance, Loan Brokerage & Mortgage Referral Services

fields.Frequency: Per customer inquiry (high volume at 200 stores + trade)
fields.Owner: Finance Desk / Sales Associate / Field Sales (VS-140)
fields.Volume: Finance inquiries across B2C homeowners + B2B trade

Automation Opportunity: - Soft-pre-qualification scoring tool; CRM lead capture; indicative-eligibility calculator
Controls: - CTL-693 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Loan Origination, Underwriting & Closing (PA-154.2).)
- CTL-693: pre-qualification indicative-only (no approval promise); soft (consented) pre-qual; lead captured (VS-13)
Cross-references: - links to VS-66/VS-11 (project/trade), VS-13/VS-107 (CRM), VS-91 (privacy), W4556 (terms), W4559 (enablement), W4562 (application)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-promise risk**: Frontline implies approval/rate before lender underwriting; mitigated by "indicative only" framing & training (W4559)
- **Privacy risk**: Premature hard credit pull; mitigated by soft pre-qualification & consent (VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - Project design (VS-66); trade (VS-11); CRM (VS-13/VS-107); privacy (VS-91); pre-qualification (W4560)

steps.activity: Finance Desk/Sales identify the finance need (home build/renovation, project size, timeline, affordability sense) during the sales/project conversation (VS-66/VS-11)
Finance Desk conduct soft pre-qualification (income/credit profile, indicative eligibility per W4556) WITHOUT a hard credit pull (privacy VS-91), and present product options
Finance Desk route qualified interest to application (W4562) with customer consent, and capture the lead in CRM (VS-13/VS-107) for follow-up/analytics (W4575)

fields.Volume: Loan applications across the partner network

Automation Opportunity: - Document-checklist/upload app; consent capture automation; lender-submission tracking
Controls: - CTL-693 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Loan Origination, Underwriting & Closing (PA-154.2).)
- CTL-693: application complete per lender checklist; consent obtained (VS-91); submission tracked
Cross-references: - links to W4560 (systems), VS-91 (privacy/consent), VS-66 (quote), W4558 (integration), W4561 (lead), W4565 (underwriting)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Incomplete-docs risk**: Application stalls on missing docs; mitigated by checklist & follow-up
- **Consent-gap risk**: Processing without consent → privacy breach (VS-91); mitigated by mandatory consent capture
System Touchpoints: - Application system (W4560); privacy/consent (VS-91); project quote (VS-66); lender integration (W4558)

steps.activity: Finance Desk collect the application & documentation (identity, income/financials, property/project docs, contractor/quote VS-66) per lender checklist (W4556)
Finance Desk/Privacy obtain consent (data-use, lender exchange, credit-bureau pull) per RA 10173 (VS-91), and validate document completeness
Finance Desk submit the complete application to the lender (W4565) and track status, keeping the customer informed

workflows.name: Credit Assessment, Affordability & Bureau Scoring Handoff

Automation Opportunity: - Lender-integrated underwriting status; decision-tracking; fair-communication templates
Controls: - CTL-693 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Loan Origination, Underwriting & Closing (PA-154.2).)
- CTL-693: underwriting is lender's role (W4557); decisions communicated fairly; consent for bureau pull (VS-91)
Cross-references: - links to W4560 (systems), VS-91 (privacy), VS-21.2/VS-22 (risk/compliance), W4557 (credit policy), W4564 (valuation), W4565 (approval)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Bias/discrimination risk**: Adverse decision based on prohibited factors; mitigated by lender's documented criteria (W4557) & BuildRight fair-communication standard
- **Slow-decision risk**: Slow underwriting kills the project sale; mitigated by SLA & lender prioritization
System Touchpoints: - Lender underwriting (W4560); credit bureau; risk (VS-21.2); privacy/consent (VS-91); compliance (VS-22)

steps.activity: Lenders perform credit assessment & affordability (bureau score, debt-to-income, income verification) — the lender's underwriting role, not BuildRight's (W4557)
Finance Desk/Lenders coordinate the credit-bureau pull & supplementary info (with consent VS-91), and respond to underwriter queries

steps.a: Lender UW Manager / Finance Desk Lead
steps.activity: Lenders/Risk capture the credit decision (approve/decline/conditions), and Finance Desk communicates to the customer fairly & without misleading reasons

Controls: - CTL-693 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Loan Origination, Underwriting & Closing (PA-154.2).)
- CTL-693: independent valuation; LTV/collateral coverage assessed; title/lien checked (VS-100.3/VS-42)
Cross-references: - links to VS-66 (project quote), VS-11 (trade), VS-42 (property), VS-100.3 (title/legal), VS-21.2 (risk), W4563 (credit), W4565 (approval)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-valuation risk**: Inflated collateral → lender loss; mitigated by independent appraisal & LTV discipline
- **Title-defect risk**: Collateral title issues; mitigated by title/lien check (VS-100.3/VS-42)
System Touchpoints: - Lender underwriting; project design/quote (VS-66); trade (VS-11); property/lease (VS-42); legal/title (VS-100.3)

steps.activity: Lenders/Appraisers arrange property/project valuation (collateral value, project scope/cost reasonableness per VS-66 quote), and title/lien check (VS-42/VS-100.3)
Project Design/Trade provide the BuildRight scope/materials quote (VS-66/VS-11) supporting the project-cost basis for the loan amount

steps.a: Lender UW Manager / Head of Internal Audit & Risk
steps.activity: Lenders/Risk assess loan-to-value/collateral coverage, set conditions, and complete the collateral assessment feeding approval (W4565)

Automation Opportunity: - Decision/condition tracking; suitability-check support; offer-comparison tooling
Controls: - CTL-693: lender underwriting documented; suitability checked (W4557); offer fit-for-purpose before customer acceptance
Cross-references: - links to W4563 (credit), W4564 (collateral), W4556 (terms), W4557 (suitability), W4566 (closing), W4567 (disbursement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unsuitable-approval risk**: Approved loan unsuitable for customer → harm/complaint; mitigated by BuildRight suitability check (W4557)
- **Condition-fatigue risk**: Excessive conditions lose the customer; mitigated by streamlined condition mgmt
System Touchpoints: - Lender underwriting; credit (W4563); collateral (W4564); product terms (W4556); suitability (W4557)

steps.activity: Lenders make the underwriting decision (approve/decline/conditioned) based on credit (W4563), collateral (W4564), and product terms (W4556), and document the rationale

steps.a: Lender UW Manager / Finance Desk Lead
steps.activity: Lenders/Finance Desk communicate conditions (additional docs, collateral, milestones) and work the customer/BuildRight to satisfy them

steps.a: Lender UW Manager / Finance Desk Lead
steps.activity: Lenders issue the approval/offer (loan amount, rate, tenor, draw schedule W4567), Finance Desk reviews fit/suitability (W4557), and supports customer decision

fields.Participants: Customer, Trade/Contractor (VS-11), Compliance (VS-22), Notary/Registry of Deeds

Automation Opportunity: - Closing/disclosure document generation; e-signature; registration tracking
Controls: - CTL-693 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Loan Origination, Underwriting & Closing (PA-154.2).)
- CTL-693: closing disclosure compliant (RA 7394/BSP VS-22); informed consent; REM registered (VS-100.3); documents lodged (VS-88)
Cross-references: - links to VS-100.3/VS-42 (legal/title), VS-88 (records), VS-22 (disclosure), VS-13 (complaints), W4565 (approval), W4567 (disbursement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Undisclosed-cost risk**: Customer surprised by fees/terms → complaint (VS-13)/regulatory; mitigated by clear closing disclosure
- **Registration-failure risk**: REM not registered → unsecured; mitigated by registration SLA (VS-100.3)

steps.activity: Lenders/Legal prepare loan/collateral documents (promissory note, real-estate mortgage/REM, disclosure statement), per lender/legal & BSP disclosure rules

steps.a: Lender UW Manager / Finance Desk Lead
steps.activity: Lenders/Finance Desk conduct closing with the customer (explain terms, fees, rate, draw schedule W4567, total cost), ensuring informed consent (RA 7394/BSP)
Legal/Notary execute & register (REM registration with Registry of Deeds, notary), and lodge documents in records (VS-88), triggering disbursement (W4567)

Controls: - CTL-693 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Loan Origination, Underwriting & Closing (PA-154.2).)
- CTL-693: draw-schedule milestone-aligned (VS-66/VS-12/W4558); billing timed to draws; escrow reconciled (VS-17/VS-18)
Cross-references: - links to VS-18/VS-17 (treasury/finance), VS-66/VS-12 (project/install), W4558 (integration), W4566 (closing), W4568 (activation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Draw-misalignment risk**: Draw timing ≠ BuildRight billing → cash strain (VS-18); mitigated by milestone-aligned billing (W4558)
- **Escrow-misuse risk**: Escrow funds misapplied; mitigated by escrow/trust controls & reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - Treasury (VS-18); finance/GL (VS-17); project design (VS-66); install (VS-12); draw integration (W4558); escrow/trust

steps.activity: Lenders/Finance Strategy set up the draw schedule (milestone-based per W4558) and escrow/trust account (where lender uses one), aligning draws to VS-66/VS-12 milestones
Lenders/Escrow release the first draw (or initial disbursement), and set the milestone-confirmation process (BuildRight confirms completion → next draw)
Treasury/Finance reconcile BuildRight invoicing vs draw releases (W4558 alignment), and manage any escrow/settlement accounting (VS-17/VS-18)

workflows.name: Post-Closing Handoff, Project Activation & Material Release

Automation Opportunity: - Funding-confirmation gate; project↔draw tracking; satisfaction/basket analytics (W4575)
Controls: - CTL-693 (ensure controlled execution — Customer Loan Origination, Underwriting & Closing (PA-154.2).)
- CTL-693: materials released only on confirmed funding (W4567); billing per draw schedule; project scope controlled (VS-66)
Cross-references: - links to VS-66/VS-12/VS-11 (project/install/trade), VS-07/VS-06 (stores/logistics), VS-13 (CRM), VS-16 (AR), W4567 (draws), W4575 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Funding-activation-gap risk**: Materials released before funding confirmed → AR risk (VS-16); mitigated by confirmed-funding gate
- **Project-loan-drift risk**: Project scope ≠ financed scope → draw disputes; mitigated by scope-control (VS-66)
System Touchpoints: - Project design (VS-66); install (VS-12); trade (VS-11); stores (VS-07); logistics (VS-06); CRM (VS-13); draw (W4567)
Time Estimate: - Per project activation ~days; relationship to completion ongoing

steps.activity: Finance Desk/Project Design hand off the financed project to execution (VS-66 design→VS-12 install/VS-11 supply), confirming funding is active (W4567)
Trade/Stores/Logistics release materials/services against the funded project (VS-11/VS-07/VS-06), billing per the draw schedule (W4567)
Finance Desk/CRM track project progress & loan draw (W4567), capture satisfaction/ basket (VS-44/W4575), and manage the relationship to completion
